facts.fact: Shirley Stone, opened 1962, on a terrace above the Willamette River in Canby.
Swan Island Dahlias, in Canby since the 1940s, calls itself the largest dahlia grower in the US.

current.subject: A glass of red wine.
current.weaknesses: A static glass; says 'wine bar' as much as 'valley'.

concepts.name: The Swirl
concepts.rationale: The glass tipped mid-swirl, Pinot climbing the far side: motion and colour.
concepts.tradeoffs: Still a wine glass; still generic to the region.

concepts.name: The Canby Dahlia
concepts.rationale: A decorative dahlia in rings of coral petals: Canby's flower fields in one bloom.
concepts.strengths: Beautiful radial icon; reads at 1x; specific to Canby.
concepts.tradeoffs: Another flower in a set with several.

recommendation: Concept 2. The dahlia is specific to Canby and is one of the most beautiful marks in the set.
